title: How to Sign In
summary: Access the EPIC Database with your organization credentials.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.body: This guide shows how to securely sign in and sign out of the EPIC Database system.

steps.title: Access the sign-in page
steps.body: Click Sign In to begin the authentication process for the EPIC Database system.

steps.title: Enter your credentials
steps.body: After entering your email and password, click Sign In to submit your credentials and log in.

steps.title: Continue verification
steps.body: Complete the verification step to continue signing in.

steps.title: Access the user dashboard
steps.body: After successful verification, you will be taken to your user dashboard.

steps.title: View and edit projects
steps.body: Once logged in, you can view and edit projects within your organization.

steps.title: Sign out
steps.body: Once you are done, click Sign Out to securely log out of the EPIC Database system.
